title: -es --- The Plural Chapter One Promised
label: ch:plural-es
canDo: I can form the plural of a word ending in a consonant, and say why the extra vowel is there.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C44-plural-es: pluralise espanol, name the word that has carried this rule since long before the chapter, and say why -s alone will not do.
payoff.note: Delivers a rule chapter one explicitly deferred. Anchored on ustedes, which the reader has used for fifty chapters without being told it was the consonant plural.
